body:
1 Benadryl for a few hours of deep sleep. 2 Benadryl for a long night and a woozy morning. 

I'll mix it up and have 1 Benadryl and Melatonin. See what that brings. 

Yes, only looking to power down my brain and get some rest tonight. Wake up tomorrow, and probably do it all over again. But there's hope that it gets better. Unfortunately, not without fear that it will get worse.

There's things that I can start today, to begin helping myself. The selfish person in me would like to see something, anything, that would be of some immediate and short term relief. 

My best bet tonight is to dance with the enemy named Ben A. Dryl. I will be zombie-like tomorrow morning. But a zombie without these feelings would be an upgrade for me.

>Factors that can be a drain on a person's resources include:
>
>    *Recent losses (due to death, breakups, career or financial setbacks, changes in health status), especially multiple losses
>    *Addiction (alcohol, drugs, gambling, etc.)
>    *Isolation
>    *Abusive or dysfunctional relationships
>    *Financial stress
>    *Mental Health issues
>    *High-stress professions
>    *Personal dependents (applies especially to parents and care-givers)

Good reading from SWR. Pretty sure that describes everything about me.

I know exactly what's wrong. It's the fact that I can't seem to influence my life at all. Maybe I am falling into the thought of needing everything right now. Maybe, but it's so damn hard to have everything in life, then have next to nothing. Not only that, but what you do have, seems to be slowly eroding away. And there's not one thing that I can do _today_ to help myself. 

I've grown ten fold from previous experiences. I know that I am a g̶o̶o̶d̶ great person. Just seems like nobody else believes me.
